newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telebras 11-mo net due out until January.
newsitem.headline: Telebras 11-mo net due out until January.

text.p: Brazil's federal telecoms company Telebras is not expected to release January-November earnings figures until the week of January 6 through 11, a company source said.
The source, who asked not to be named, said the company does not plan to release the 11-month figures at the end of December as originally planned because of the holidays.
"The routine is that it comes on the last week of the following month but, because its a holiday and so many people are away, it won't happen until the week of January 6-11," the source said.
Telebras posted a 10-month net consolidated profit of 2.02 billion reais, up from about 800 million reais in all of 1995.
The Brazilian government next year plans to break up and begin privatizing the Telebras system, which includes 27 local subsidiaries and long-distance unit Embratel.
